lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, roughly circular blobs are arranged in semi-linear horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with a prominent triplet of larger centroids forming an obtuse triangular arrangement in the central visible flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of blobs, creating a discernible grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with high luminance on the superior edge and deep shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of small, irregularly shaped high-luminance blobs that are significantly smaller and more densely packed than the primary constellation on the main body flank.
